operation.summary: Bring an installed applet's portal to the front of the screen (any applet), as if the owner tapped Open. Waits for its page to load and expose its functions

body.name: wait_s
body.description: 0-15 seconds to wait for the page (default 5)

operation.returns: as GET …/portal, plus note when the portal didn't come to the front. portal.opened, portal.functions, portal.state and portal.closed follow in /v1/events

wait_s.description: 0-15 seconds to wait for the page (default 5)
